entities.summary: Johan Krouthén was a Swedish artist. He broke away from the traditions of the Swedish Academy, turning to Realism and Idealism. Immediately after his studies, he spent a few months in Paris and in Denmark where he associated with the Skagen Painters. Back in Sweden he painted pictures of gardens and portraits of local people. Johan Krouthén was a authors & novelists from Linköping Cathedral Congregation (1858-11-02, Linköping Cathedral Congregation–1932-12-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
